name: fusion-vqc-v1
note: 8-qubit angle-encoded VQC, CNOT ring. Served backend (AURA_FUSION_BACKEND default in pyproject). Native shot-noise uncertainty + QMBA. See docs/QUANTUM.md.

name: fusion-poe-v1
note: Bayesian product-of-experts. Fair-benchmark accuracy winner; retained as interpretable fallback and as the conflict-guard reference the VQC defers to.

calibration.note: Shared safety.npz mirrors the served (quantum) backend; per-backend fits live in safety_{backend}.npz and are preferred by Calibration.load(backend=...).
